html:
The Yiman, also written Jiman, were an Aboriginal Australian people of the upper Dawson River in central Queensland, around today's Taroom.

Ludwig Leichhardt crossed their country in 1844, and squatters followed in the 1850s. In October 1857 Yiman men attacked Hornet Bank station and killed members of the Fraser family and their workers, in what is called the Hornet Bank massacre. Settlers and the Native Police answered with months of killings across the district, which nearly destroyed the Yiman as a people.

Their neighbours included the Kongabula, Wuli Wuli and Mandandanji.
sum: The Yiman, also written Jiman, were an Aboriginal Australian people of the upper Dawson River in central Queensland, around today's Taroom.
